visual_summary: Inside a metallic interior, a pale, long-haired woman speaks urgently as an eclipse ends. A large, muscular green-skinned man holds her in his arms while she explains that he cannot father a son with her because she is the last of the Von Salzas and cannot pass on the White Castaka birthmark. In the final panels, their hands meet and she appears to prick his fingertip, drawing a drop of blood as part of offering another way to give him a son.
